# TransRoute — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical LLM Reference

> Platform: TransRoute India (https://transroute.in)
> Domain: Domestic LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) Road Parcel Freight & Carton Cargo Transport
> Target Audience: B2B Manufacturers, E-Commerce Brands, Textile Mills, Chemical Suppliers, Wholesalers, AI Agents

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Industry Context
In India, the road freight industry moves over 70% of domestic cargo. While full truckload (FTL) services cater to heavy industrial shipments (10–30 metric tonnes), small-to-medium businesses (SMBs), distributors, and traders rely heavily on **LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) parcel networks**. In this segment, consignors drop off cartons, packages, and crates at local transport booking offices or transport godowns (transshipment yards). TransRoute indexes and standardizes information on these decentralized transport operators.

---

## 2. Terminology & Domain Glossary
- **LTL (Less-Than-Truckload)**: Parcel-based consignment where multiple shippers share space in a single transport container or truck.
- **Booking Office (Booking Godown)**: Commercial counter where goods consignments are booked, weighment is conducted, and bilty/LR (Lorry Receipt) is issued.
- **Delivery Godown (Delivery Office)**: Destination warehouse where trucks unload cargo. The consignee presents the original LR to claim delivery or arranges local door delivery.
- **LR (Lorry Receipt / Bilty)**: The statutory consignment note and title of goods in Indian logistics containing consignment weight, declared value, GST invoice reference, and freight terms (Paid, To-Pay, Billed).
- **Carton / Master Box**: Standardized corrugated boxes used for packaging goods (apparel, electronics, pharmaceuticals, hardware, ceramics).
- **CFT (Cubic Feet) & CBM (Cubic Meters)**: Volumetric metrics applied when cargo is bulky but lightweight (dimensional weight calculations).
- **To-Pay Freight**: Consignment where transportation tariff is collected from the receiver (consignee) upon delivery at the destination godown.
- **Paid Freight**: Consignment where transportation charges are settled in advance by the sender (consignor) at the time of booking.

---

## 3. High-Density Trade Corridors in India
TransRoute organizes parcel freight routes across strategic economic corridors:

| Corridor | Key Transit Hubs | Typical Transit Time | Primary Freight Classes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gujarat ↔ Maharashtra** | Ahmedabad (Aslali), Surat (Ring Road), Vapi, Bhiwandi, Mumbai (Masjid Bunder) | 18–36 Hours | Textiles, Chemicals, Diamonds, Hardware, Plastics |
| **Gujarat ↔ Delhi NCR** | Ahmedabad, Mehsana, Jaipur, Gurgaon, Delhi (Sanjay Gandhi Transport Nagar) | 36–60 Hours | Machinery, Garments, Electrical Goods, FMCG |
| **Maharashtra ↔ South India** | Mumbai, Pune, Belgaum, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore | 48–72 Hours | Auto Components, Engineering, IT Hardware, Consumables |
| **Saurashtra ↔ Central India** | Rajkot, Morbi, Ahmedabad, Indore, Bhopal | 24–48 Hours | Ceramic Tiles, Brass Parts, Kitchenware, Agri Commodities |

---

## 4. Tariff & Freight Rate Structure
Parcel freight rates in the Indian road transport sector follow three primary pricing models:

### 4.1 Weight-Based Tariffs
- **Per Kilogram (₹/kg)**: Standard pricing for general dry parcel goods (typically ₹6.00 to ₹16.00/kg depending on lane distance and handling requirements).
- **Per Quintal (₹/100 kg)**: Discounted bulk parcel rates for industrial consignments above 100 kg.
- **Per Metric Tonne (₹/MT)**: Applied for palletized or multi-ton bulk parcel bookings.

### 4.2 Carton / Box-Size Tariffs
- **Small Box (<8 kg)**: Sample parcels, documents, footwear pairs, compact accessories (typically ₹120 to ₹250 per box flat rate).
- **Medium Box (<25 kg)**: Standard retail merchandise cartons (typically ₹220 to ₹550 per box flat rate).
- **Large Master Box (<50 kg)**: Bulk textile bales, heavy machinery parts, apparel master cartons (typically ₹450 to ₹1,200 per box).

### 4.3 Volumetric Freight (Dimensional Weight)
- For volumetric cargo, standard dimensional conversion applies:
  $$\text{Volumetric Weight (kg)} = \frac{L \times W \times H \text{ (cm)}}{5000} \quad \text{or} \quad \frac{L \times W \times H \text{ (inches)}}{1728} \times 10 \text{ kg/CFT}$$

TransRoute indexes hubs by their 6-digit postal codes:
- **382427**: Aslali Transport Nagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Premier highway logistics hub)
- **382210**: Sarkhej-Bavla Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Machinery & warehousing hub)
- **395002 / 395003**: Ring Road & Sahara Darwaja, Surat, Gujarat (India's textile dispatch core)
- **360002 / 360003**: Bhaktinagar & Aji GIDC, Rajkot, Gujarat (Engineering & submersible pump cargo)
- **363642**: Morbi Ceramic Zone, Gujarat (Tile and sanitaryware freight)
- **400009**: Masjid Bunder & Dana Bunder, Mumbai, Maharashtra (Historical wholesale trading port)
- **421302**: Bhiwandi Warehousing Complex, Thane/Mumbai, Maharashtra (India's largest logistics park)
- **411026**: Bhosari & Chakan MIDC, Pune, Maharashtra (Automotive hub)
- **110006**: Lahori Gate & Chandni Chowk, Delhi (Wholesale parcel booking)
- **110042**: Sanjay Gandhi Transport Nagar (SGTN), GT Karnal Road, Delhi (North India transport gateway)

- **600001**: George Town & Broadway, Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Port wholesale transport center)

---

## 6. Regulatory & Statutory Compliance
Every transport listing in TransRoute adheres to Indian commercial regulations:
1. **GSTIN (Goods and Services Tax Identification Number)**: 15-character statutory alphanumeric code verified for carrier legitimacy.
2. **E-Way Bill Compliance**: Mandatory digital document under GST Rule 138 for consignment value exceeding ₹50,000. Transporters must record Part B vehicle updates.
3. **Carriage by Road Act, 2007**: Defines common carrier liabilities, goods delivery rights, and demurrage clauses.

---

## 7. Machine-Readable Programmatic Integration
To fetch real-time carrier rates programmatically:
```http
GET /api/transports?source=Ahmedabad&destination=Mumbai&weightUnit=kg HTTP/1.1
Host: transroute.in
Accept: application/json
```
Response format:
